club: Caldecote FC — The Pavilion, Harvey Close, Upper Caldecote
notes: The club line's version of record. The base system's version lives in app/package.json and is NOT touched here, so that merging a base release forward never lands on a version conflict. release-caldecote.yml checks the number below against the version it is asked to publish.
whyThisCut: 0.0.1 could not show the club. The wall was built and tested against the engine configured directly, but a flashed card runs the app, which embeds the engine under /feeds — and nothing passed a club config to it. So caldecote-0.0.1's image answered /feeds/clubhouse with PitchTribe's name, the countdown, and no football: the right page with the wrong club, which is the one failure nobody catches in a screenshot. PR #43 reads a club file from the data directory and hands its leagues, timezone and clubhouse section to the embedded engine. 0.0.1 should not be flashed; it is left published rather than deleted because deleting a tag somebody may have already written down is worse than marking it superseded.
baseNote: The base pointer above is unchanged from 0.0.1's record and is what this line stands on: main @ 1d9ec6f (v0.4.2 +38). 0.0.1 was tagged at main @ e59050a (v0.4.2 +30); main @ efe29eea was merged forward on 14 November 2026 under PIT-49, bringing #39 (release image permissions), #40 (sortEvents total order) and #41 (manual status phrase), and main @ 1d9ec6f was merged forward later the same day under PIT-52, bringing #42, the test-only fix for the 1.95% flaky spot-the-ball assertion. No base merge happened for this cut: 0.0.2 is 0.0.1's base plus the club fix in #43, so if the soak behaves differently the difference is that fix and nothing else.
